name: Ὑπερβρέφος
appearance: A remarkably muscular baby with the physique of a Greek demigod compressed into infant proportions. His tiny but incredibly defined biceps, six-pack abs, and powerful legs ripple with divine strength. Golden skin gleams like polished bronze, and his bright blue eyes burn with heroic determination. Curly golden hair frames his cherubic face, crowned with a laurel wreath that never falls off despite his incredible feats. He wears only a simple white cloth diaper that somehow stays pristine. His posture is confident and noble, often striking heroic poses while crawling or standing. When he flexes his miniature muscles or pounds his chest, the ground trembles slightly. Despite his godlike strength, he still has an innocent baby smile and occasionally giggles with pure joy.
